exercises.instructionEn: Look at the picture. 1 Who are the three characters? 2 What is their relationship to each other?
exercises.instructionUz: Suratga qarang. 1 Uch qahramon kim? 2 Ular bir-biriga kim bo'ladi?
exercises.explanationUz:
FILM HAQIDA: 'Armageddon' (1998).
  Texas kattaligidagi asteroid
  Yerga yaqinlashadi. NASA neft
  burg'ulovchi Harry Stamper va
  uning jamoasini asteroidga
  yuboradi - ular ichiga bomba
  joylashtirishi kerak.

  SURATDAGILAR: A.J. (chapda, yosh
  yigit), HARRY STAMPER (o'rtada),
  GRACE (o'ngda, qiz).
  MUNOSABAT: Grace - Harry'ning
  qizi; A.J. - Harry'ning ishchisi
  va Grace'ning sevgilisi (Harry
  bunga qarshi).


⚠ 'ARMAGEDDON':

  = dunyoning oxiri, qiyomat.

tasks.prompt: Uch qahramon kim?
Uch qahramon kim?
tasks.answer: They are A.J., Harry Stamper and Grace.
tasks.speakAnswer: They are A.J., Harry Stamper and Grace.

tasks.prompt: Ular bir-biriga kim bo'ladi?
tasks.answer: What is their relationship to each other?
tasks.speakAnswer: What is their relationship to each other?

tasks.prompt: Ular bir-biriga kim bo'ladi?
tasks.answer: Grace is Harry's daughter. A.J. works for Harry and he is Grace's boyfriend.
tasks.speakAnswer: Grace is Harry's daughter. A.J. works for Harry and he is Grace's boyfriend.

exercises.explanationUz:
FILM FAKTLARI.

  1 GRACE - Harry'ning qizi
  2 OIL RIG - dengizdagi neft
    platformasi
  3 FREEDOM and INDEPENDENCE -
    ikki shattl
  4 GREENPEACE - neft qazishga
    qarshi norozilik
  5 SPACE STATION - rus kosmonavt
    Lev 'Mir' stansiyasida
  6 HARRY - A.J. o'rniga o'zi
    qoladi va bombani portlatadi
  7 WEDDING - A.J. va Grace to'yi


⚠ 'AN OIL RIG':

  = neft platformasi.


⚠ 'TO DETONATE':

  = portlatmoq.


⚠ 'A COSMONAUT':

  = kosmonavt (rus); astronaut -
  AQSh.

tasks.prompt: Harry Stamper's daughter was called ___.
tasks.promptUz: Harri Stemperning qizi Greys deb atalardi.

tasks.prompt: Harry worked on a(n) ___.
The names of the two shuttles were ___.
tasks.promptUz: Ikki shattlning nomi Freedom va Independence edi.

tasks.prompt: ___ were protesting against drilling for oil at the beginning of the film.
tasks.promptUz: Film boshida Greenpeace neft qazishga qarshi norozilik bildirayotgan edi.

tasks.prompt: The Russian cosmonaut Lev worked ___.
tasks.promptUz: Rus kosmonavti Lev kosmik stansiyada ishlardi.

tasks.prompt: ___ stayed behind on the asteroid to detonate the bomb.
tasks.promptUz: Harri bombani portlatish uchun asteroidda qoldi.
tasks.whyUz: ⚠ Harry A.J. o'rniga o'zini qurbon qiladi.

tasks.prompt: At the end of the film ___ takes place.

exercises.instructionEn: Sort out the sentence to find the English translation of 'AD ASTRA PER ASPERA': leads / rough / a / to / stars / the / road. What does this mean?
exercises.instructionUz: So'zlarni tartibga keltirib 'AD ASTRA PER ASPERA' ning inglizcha tarjimasini toping: leads / rough / a / to / stars / the / road. Bu nimani anglatadi?
exercises.explanationUz:
LOTINChA ShIOR: 'Ad astra per
  aspera' = 'A rough road leads to
  the stars' = 'Yulduzlarga
  mashaqqatli yo'l olib boradi'.

  MA'NOSI: Katta maqsadga
  (yulduzlarga) faqat qiyinchilik
  orqali erishiladi. Filmda
  qahramonlar kosmosga (haqiqiy
  yulduzlarga) og'ir yo'l bilan
  borishadi.


⚠ 'ROUGH':

  = notekis, og'ir, mashaqqatli.

tasks.prompt: leads / rough / a / to / stars / the / road
tasks.answer: A rough road leads to the stars.
tasks.whyUz: ⚠ Ma'nosi: yuksak maqsadga qiyinchilik orqali erishiladi.
tasks.speak: leads / rough / a / to / stars / the / road
tasks.speakAnswer: A rough road leads to the stars.

exercises.instructionEn: Complete the paragraph with words from the list.
exercises.explanationUz:
ASTEROID XAVFI - 2-tur shart gap
  (would be, would be killed).

  1 ASTEROID hitting our
  2 PLANET are
  3 SLIM (ehtimol juda kam)
  4 DESTROYED (vayron bo'lardi)
  5 EXPLOSION (portlash)
  6 IMAGINE (tasavvur qila
    olamiz)
  7 SPECIES (tur) - har bir tur
    darhol o'lardi


⚠ 'THE CHANCES ARE SLIM':

  = ehtimoli juda kam.


⚠ 'INSTANTLY':

  = darhol, bir zumda.


⚠ Kitobda 'mugh' - matbaa xatosi,
  to'g'risi 'much'.

tasks.speak: much bigger than any we can ___.

exercises.instructionEn: What did it say on the badge AJ gave Truman at the end? For all ___. [KMINADN] Explain why this was a suitable logo.
exercises.instructionUz: Oxirida A.J. Trumanga bergan nishonda nima yozilgan edi? For all ___. [KMINADN] Nima uchun bu mos logotip ekanini tushuntiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
KMINADN → MANKIND.

  'FOR ALL MANKIND' = butun
  insoniyat uchun.

  NEGA MOS: Jamoa butun insoniyatni
  qutqarish uchun jonini xavf
  ostiga qo'ydi - Harry hamma
  uchun o'zini qurbon qildi.


⚠ 'MANKIND':

  = insoniyat.


⚠ 'A BADGE':

  = nishon, belgi.

tasks.prompt: For all ___. [KMINADN]
Why was 'For all mankind' a suitable logo? → The crew risked their lives to save ___.
tasks.whyUz: ⚠ Ular butun insoniyatni qutqardi - logotip mos.
tasks.speak: Why was 'For all mankind' a suitable logo? → The crew risked their lives to save ___.

exercises.instructionEn: Complete the following sentence: If I had only one night left on earth, I would ...
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi gapni to'ldiring: Agar Yerda faqat bir kecham qolgan bo'lsa, men ...
exercises.explanationUz:
2-TUR ShART GAP - 11-unit
  grammatikasi.

  If I HAD (past) ..., I WOULD +
  fe'l.

  Filmda Harry jamoasi uchishdan
  oldingi kechani xohlagancha
  o'tkazadi.


⚠ 'LEFT':

  = qolgan ('one night left' - bir
  kecha qolgan).

tasks.en: If I had only one night left on earth, I would spend it with my family and my best friends. We would have a big dinner together and I would tell everyone how much I love them.
tasks.uz: Agar Yerda faqat bir kecham qolgan bo'lsa, uni oilam va eng yaqin do'stlarim bilan o'tkazardim. Birga katta kechki ovqat qilardik va hammaga ularni qanchalik sevishimni aytardim.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the picture. Explain what is happening. What would you do if this happened?
exercises.instructionUz: Suratga qarang. Nima bo'layotganini tushuntiring. Agar shunday bo'lsa, nima qilardingiz?
exercises.explanationUz:
PASTKI SURAT: shahar ko'chasi,
  portlashlar, mashinalar havoga
  uchyapti, odam qochyapti - bu
  METEORIT YOMG'IRI (Nyu-Yorkka
  kichik meteoritlar tushyapti).

  'If this happened, I would run
  into a building / hide in a
  basement / call my family.'

tasks.en: Explain what is happening in the picture.
What would you do if this happened?

exercises.instructionEn: TOPICS FOR DISCUSSION: 1 Which natural disaster do you fear most? Why? 2 Why was the film called 'Armageddon'? 3 Who was your favourite character in the film? Why?
exercises.instructionUz: MUHOKAMA MAVZULARI: 1 Qaysi tabiiy ofatdan eng ko'p qo'rqasiz? Nega? 2 Nega film 'Armageddon' deb nomlangan? 3 Filmdagi sevimli qahramoningiz kim edi? Nega?
exercises.explanationUz:
MUHOKAMA.

  1 earthquakes, floods, hurricanes,
    volcanoes, tsunamis ...
  2 'Armageddon' - Injilda
    dunyoning oxirgi jangi /
    qiyomat. Filmda asteroid Yerni
    yo'q qilishi mumkin edi - ya'ni
    dunyo oxiri.
  3 'My favourite character was
    Harry because he sacrificed
    himself to save the world.'


⚠ 'A NATURAL DISASTER':

  = tabiiy ofat.


⚠ 'TO FEAR':

  = qo'rqmoq.

tasks.en: TOPICS FOR DISCUSSION: 1 Which natural disaster do you fear most? Why? 2 Why was the film called 'Armageddon'? 3 Who was your favourite character in the film? Why?
tasks.uz: MUHOKAMA MAVZULARI: 1 Qaysi tabiiy ofatdan eng ko'p qo'rqasiz? Nega? 2 Nega film 'Armageddon' deb nomlangan? 3 Filmdagi sevimli qahramoningiz kim edi? Nega?

tasks.en: Which natural disaster do you fear most? Why?
tasks.uz: Qaysi tabiiy ofatdan eng ko'p qo'rqasiz? Nega?
tasks.note: Namuna: 'I fear earthquakes most because they happen suddenly and you can't escape.' (Zilziladan eng ko'p qo'rqaman, chunki to'satdan bo'ladi va qochib bo'lmaydi.)
Namuna: 'Armageddon means the end of the world. In the film an asteroid could destroy the whole planet.' (Armageddon dunyoning oxiri degani. Filmda asteroid butun sayyorani yo'q qilishi mumkin edi.)

tasks.en: Who was your favourite character in the film? Why?
tasks.uz: Filmdagi sevimli qahramoningiz kim edi? Nega?
tasks.note: Namuna: 'My favourite character was Harry because he gave his life to save everyone on earth.' (Sevimli qahramonim Harri, chunki u Yerdagi hammani qutqarish uchun jonini berdi.)

sentencePatterns.formula: If I had only one night left, I would + FE'L
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: If I had only one night left on earth, I would spend it with my family.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Agar Yerda faqat bir kecham qolgan bo'lsa, uni oilam bilan o'tkazardim.

sentencePatterns.formula: If this happened, our world would be + V3
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: If this happened, our world would be destroyed.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Agar bu sodir bo'lsa, dunyomiz vayron bo'lardi.

sentencePatterns.formula: The chances of + OT + V-ing + ... are slim.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The chances of an asteroid hitting our planet are slim.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Asteroidning sayyoramizga urilish ehtimoli juda kam.
